name: zync-mcp
description: Connects Claude to a self-hosted Zync server over MCP (read + propose-only write) and teaches it how to help triage the inbox and organize Reference.

server_url.title: Zync server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Zync server, e.g. https://zync.example.com — no trailing slash, no /mcp suffix (the plugin appends it).

token.title: Zync bot token
token.description: A bearer token minted on your Zync server with `server bot add <name>`. Only the token's SHA-256 hash is stored server-side; the token itself is never written anywhere in this repo — Claude Code stores it locally when you enter it here.
